stem.text: When $\text{CH}_2\text{(OH)CH=CHCO}_2\text{H}$ is warmed with a little concentrated sulfuric acid, a cyclic compound is formed.
What is the skeletal formula of the cyclic compound?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a five-membered ring containing an oxygen atom, with two C=O groups.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a five-membered ring containing an oxygen atom, a C=O group and a C=C.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a five-membered ring containing an oxygen atom, a C=C and a C=O group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a five-membered ring containing an oxygen atom, a C=C and two C=O groups.
